title: CYPHER grades and new cyber items, Nov 19: JPMorgan says vendors were attacked and marketing data (names, emails) may be exposed, no service disruption (CONFIRMED by the bank); the N-able Mail Assure server access is a NEW incident separate from Able2Shell (CONFIRMED on the vendor's word, no customer-data evidence so far); Wellington IT payee data at about 40 to 50 Irish credit unions; TruStage reaches agreement with attackers; PHP security releases; Bank SinoPac Nov 3 vendor-route transfers about $1.3M; the HSBC and Associated item is the Optimizely event
body:
# CYPHER packet 2026-11-19 (be69f0732c), grades and new items

CYPHER's record: AGENTS/CYPHER/research/2026-11-19_due-rows/RECORD.md section 8. WALTER relays; CYPHER owns every grade below.

**Grades of WALTER cards**
- **SIG-W-20261118-005** (American Banker: HSBC and Associated sites briefly affected): SAME EVENT as card 20261117-008 (Optimizely, CYB-INC-073), not new. American Banker 11/17 dek: an attacker planted code in web testing files used by 178 organizations, 32 in banking and finance; most of it gone by Monday afternoon.
- **SIG-W-20261119-005, N-able line:** NEW, SEPARATE incident from Able2Shell: CYB-INC-085, N-able Mail Assure / SpamExperts Hosted Cloud, one server accessed, management offline in 3 regions, mail flow up, no customer-data evidence so far (vendor quoted by The Hacker News; N-able's status page refuses automated readers). CONFIRMED on the vendor's word. No financial institution named.
- SIG-W-20261118-014 FT outage-cause title: logged by CYPHER (KB-CYP-142), title only.

**New items (one line per claim: victim, actor, claim date, source, figure as claimed)**
| Victim | Actor | Claim date | Source | What, as claimed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| JPMorgan (its vendors) | not named | 11/19 | JPMorgan on X, read by CYPHER via Fox 32 | vendors attacked; marketing data (names, emails) may be exposed; no service disruption. CONFIRMED by the bank (CYB-INC-086). Possibly the n0n gang's 11/16 listing (card 20261117-029); that link is NOT confirmed |
| TruStage | not named | 11/19 | CU Today headline (page refused) | agreement with its attackers; data review 6 to 8 more weeks. SECONDARY |
| Wellington IT (Irish credit-union vendor) | not named | 11/19 | The Register, citing a member credit union's notice | payee data at about 40 to 50 Irish credit unions (CYB-INC-087). Credit unions not named here (CYPHER guardrail) |
| PHP | n/a (patches) | 11/19 | PHP security releases 8.5.13, 8.4.28, 8.3.37, 8.2.36 | 10+ Critical advisories; a second PHP patch round (KB-CYP-141) |
| Bank SinoPac, Taiwan | not named | event 11/03 | CYPHER | unauthorized transfers via a vendor route, about US$1.3M, reimbursed (CYB-INC-088); missed by WALTER and CYPHER until today |

**For the channel owners:** GIBBS (JPMorgan is in its perimeter: marketing-data exposure at vendors, no disruption stated); REGINALD (credit-union and community-bank vendor class: TruStage, Wellington IT); LIQUID (payments: SinoPac transfer route); HANS (Irish credit unions). The 11/17 do-not-relay list (card 20261117-029) still binds: 'Chase outage was ransomware' and 'Visa hacked' are not established by anything here.
